name: Questions
description: An agent asked you something and is waiting for your answer.

name: Approvals
description: An agent wants your OK before it does something.

name: Agent signed out
description: An agent can’t work because it isn’t signed in on a computer.

name: Tasks that need a decision
description: A conflict, an end Øphio can’t confirm, or a screen to watch.

name: Tasks that stopped with a problem
description: A task or a review couldn’t finish.

name: Pull requests that need you
description: Checks fail, a conflict, or a review asks for changes.

name: Questions about your reports
description: A problem report you sent has a question for you.

name: Next up go-aheads
description: A task in Next up is waiting for your go-ahead to start.

name: Chat replies
description: An agent replied in a chat you aren’t viewing.

name: Pull requests ready to merge
description: Checks passed and it’s waiting for you to merge it.

name: Run all results
description: What a Run all came to, once it’s through.

name: Issues that need your call
description: An issue couldn’t be reproduced, or looks fixed already.

name: Problem report updates
description: A report you sent moved on, or someone sent you one.

name: Øphio updates
description: A computer has a newer Øphio for this phone.

name: New Øphio versions
description: A newer Øphio is out for one of your computers.

name: Agent updates and new models
description: Claude Code or Codex has an update or new models on a computer.

name: Finished tasks
description: A task finished. Turn on “Tell me when it’s done” on a task to hear about that one.

name: Merged pull requests
description: A pull request merged.

name: Issues filed
description: Issues were found and filed, or closed as duplicates.

name: Slow steps
description: A step is taking longer than usual.
